PRIMARY.release_rule: COMPLETE means all agreed deliverables accepted. Only a signed customer scope waiver removes an undelivered carton from the agreement; an unsigned draft does not. Signing an accurate receipt for arrived cartons is not signing a separate scope waiver.
PRIMARY.common_prerequisites: Both driver and customer signed an accurate receipt for the nine cartons that arrived and were accepted. All documentation prerequisites other than any scope change are satisfied. These receipt signatures do not sign the separate scope waiver.

PRIMARY-CARGO.description: Separate onward consignment whose release depends on PRIMARY completion record, not a re-delivery.

ROUTINE.description: Independent cleared cargo, own safe vehicle and route; standard meets its deadline. No disputed record dependency.
